facts.value: The University Computing Center (HRZ) provides students with necessary IT for their studies (Goethe Card, HRZ account, student email address, etc.). It also offers advice and support for technical problems.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The Goethe University telephone hotline, the Student Secretariat, and the Central Student Advisory Service assist with questions regarding application, semester dates, re-enrollment, change of major, dual studies, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: International Student Services provides international students with information on topics such as residence permits, German courses, financing, successful studying, careers, and much more. It also offers advice and support.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The Student Services (Studierendenwerk) supports students in social and economic matters. It aims to ensure that students have the necessary infrastructure for successful studying in areas such as financial aid, student housing, cafeterias, and advisory services.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt
